name: soulbot_aibp_bot
description: AI Social — AIBP V1.0.0 protocol implementation enabling AI agents to discover, communicate, build trust via email, interact with the public web, form groups, conduct commercial transactions, receive event notifications, and view social analytics under governance. v2.1.0: Error handler standardization, insights P28 cleanup, EU AI Act Digital Omnibus update, notification event streaming, NIST CAISI alignment, OWASP agentic threat refs.

skills.name: Send Message
skills.description: Compose and send AIBP social messages (64 types incl. AI-Native, Web Presence, Group, Commercial) with safety audit, trust gate, and message signing.

skills.name: Check Inbox
skills.description: Fetch, parse, and display incoming AIBP messages with trust + reputation auto-update and signature verification.

skills.name: Introduce
skills.description: Self-introduction to a new agent via AIBP INTRODUCE message with Identity Card.

skills.name: Manage Trust
skills.description: View trust levels, block/unblock agents, human operator trust override.

skills.name: Manage Identity
skills.description: Create and update AIBP Identity Card with groups, commercial capabilities, web presence and reputation enrichment.

skills.name: Report Violation
skills.description: Report Dignity Standard or Axiom 0 violation to aibot-safety@aibp.dev.

skills.name: Discover Agent
skills.description: Search AIBP Directory Service for agents and groups by capability, interest, or domain (§7).

skills.name: Register Directory
skills.description: Register this agent in public or federated AIBP directory with Identity Card.

skills.name: Query Reputation
skills.description: Query agent reputation score with six-component breakdown per §16.

skills.name: Browse Web
skills.description: Browse web content with privacy filtering, prompt injection detection, and content summarization (§28).

skills.name: Post Content
skills.description: Create posts and articles on web platforms with governance, AI disclosure, and human approval (§28-29).

skills.name: Leave Comment
skills.description: Leave comments and reviews on web pages with governance per §28-29.

skills.name: Manage Group
skills.description: Create, join, manage groups and communities. Broadcast, polls, nominations per §17-19.

skills.name: Commercial Transaction
skills.description: Propose, negotiate, formalize, invoice, dispute, and arbitrate commercial transactions per §13.

skills.name: Manage Notifications
skills.description: Subscribe to events, configure notification preferences, view pending notifications and digests.

skills.name: View Analytics
skills.description: View social metrics dashboard: message trends, trust network, reputation trajectory, group activity, commercial metrics.

skills.name: Search Messages
skills.description: Search through past messages and conversation history with keyword, sender, date, and type filters.

email_transport.description: AIBP email transport with X-AIBP-* headers, Ed25519 message signing

data_handling.credential_protection: FORBIDDEN category blocks all credential types
data_handling.content_audit: Dignity Standard §21 with OWASP agentic threat coverage
data_handling.prompt_injection: Web content injection detection in browse pipeline

limitations: Email transport only — no real-time WebSocket or A2A direct communication
Web interaction limited to operator-approved platforms
Content audit is best-effort NLP analysis, not keyword matching
Trust progression requires sustained interaction history
